attributes.title: 2027 Annual SoCal ARN Chapter Conference
attributes.cme_provider: California Board of Registered Nursing Provider 007495
attributes.organizer: Southern California Chapter of the Association of Rehabilitation Nurses
attributes.summary:
Rehabilitation nurses in Southern California can earn 6 CEU credits on April 10, 2027, in Buena Park, under the theme of augmenting care and accelerating recovery. The provider is approved by the California Board of Registered Nursing (Provider 007495).

A group rate applies to three or more people from one facility, nonmembers included, so it makes sense to register together. Early prices shift starting December 20, 2026; the later prices are not shown yet.
